data.name: Iron Rose: Escape
data.detailed_description:
《Iron Rose: Escape》 is a medieval-style platform action game. Players take on the role of a female warrior seeking self-redemption from a mysterious organization. Through exquisitely designed and diverse levels, she battles relentlessly, breaks through encirclements, and ultimately reaches the shore of spiritual freedom.
This demo includes selected content from the first four levels, allowing players to experience complete small-level gameplay and the boss battle in the second level, showcasing the game's combat and level design charm.

【Core Gameplay】
Unique Attack System: Execute various attacks through consecutive button combinations.
Aerial Assault: Launch strikes against high-altitude enemies while jumping.
Charged Heavy Attack: Press and hold Q to gather strength and unleash a deadly strike.
Agile Dodge: Use the S + D combination to perform a roll and quickly escape danger.

【Control Scheme】
Movement: W A S D
Attack: Mouse Left Click
Charged Attack: Q
Roll: S + D

Embark on your journey, and carve a path to redemption amidst the intertwined fate of sword and rose.
